verdict.rationale: The only pricing disclosure is the Global Employment & Equity Compensation Solutions page, which says services are delivered 'all on a fixed-fee basis'. That is a single, thin public statement of an alternative fee arrangement for one practice. The free Tech Studio resources are no-cost self-service tools, not disclosures of how legal engagements are priced. Missing for 10: published rate structures or hourly-rate guidance, a firm-wide statement on alternative fee arrangements, billing-practice or invoicing policies, fee details for core practices (venture, M&A, litigation, IP), and independent corroboration of the pricing claims.
